name: Dhruva
description: A town built around one fixed point and oriented to it, every street a spoke. The point is a pillar, and the town has grown outward from it in rings so regular that the regularity reads as fear.

pois.label: The fixed pillar
pois.text: Square, unmarked, taller than the roofs around it. It does not sway in wind. Set into its base is a ring of iron, and the iron is worn bright on the inside.

pois.label: First ring street
pois.text: The houses here face the pillar and not each other. Doors are cut to line up with it. Walk the ring and every doorway points the same way.

pois.label: Surveyor's house
pois.text: The only building that faces out. Inside, cord and plumb weights are hung and still. A chart on the table has the pillar at the centre and one arm drawn longer than the rest.
